facts.statement: Teleosaurus was approximately 3 meters in length.
facts.quote: It was approximately 3 m in length.

facts.statement: Teleosaurus had a long, slender body and a sinuous tail used for propulsion in water.
facts.quote: It had a long, slender, body, with a sinuous tail that would have helped propel it through the water.

facts.statement: Teleosaurus had remarkably short forelimbs that were likely held close to the body while swimming to improve streamlining.
facts.quote: Its forelimbs were remarkably short, and would probably have been held close to the body when swimming to improve the animal's streamlining.

facts.statement: Teleosaurus is an extinct genus of thalattosuchian reptiles, distant relatives of modern crocodiles adapted to ocean life, that lived during the Middle Jurassic in Europe.
facts.quote: Teleosaurus es un género extinto de saurópsidos (reptiles) talatosuquios, es decir parientes lejanos de los cocodrilos actuales adaptados a la vida oceánica, que vivió durante el Jurásico Medio en Europa.

facts.statement: Teleosaurus lost its heavy bony armor, and its skin became much smoother and slippery.
facts.quote: Perdieron la pesada coraza ósea, y su piel se volvió mucho más lisa y resbaladiza.

facts.statement: Teleosaurus had palmated feet resembling flippers.
facts.quote: Las patas eran palmeadas, semejantes a aletas.

facts.statement: Teleosaurus had a tail that became thinner and longer, resembling a fin.
facts.quote: La cola se hizo más fina y larga, también más parecida a una aleta.

facts.statement: Teleosaurus had several rows of needle-like teeth used to catch slippery fish and squid.
facts.quote: Varias hileras de dientes como agujas les servían para capturar peces y calamares escurridizos.

facts.statement: Like aquatic turtles, Teleosaurus only went to shore to lay eggs.
facts.quote: Como las tortugas acuáticas, sólo subía a la orilla para desovar.

facts.statement: Teleosaurus had eyes on the top of its head, allowing it to see above the water.
facts.quote: Los ojos en la parte superior de la cabeza le servían para poder ver sobre el agua.

facts.statement: Teleosaurus measured just over 4 meters in length.
Marine crocodiles like Teleosaurus likely incubated eggs internally, with hatchlings emerging fully formed and ready to swim, breathe, and eat.
facts.quote: Algunas especies de cocodrilo marino incubaban los huevos en el interior. Dentro del vientre, las crías rompían el cascarón. Salían del huevo, y luego de la madre, completamente formadas y listas para nadar, respirar y comer.

facts.statement: A 2019 review of Teleosauroidea taxonomy concluded that T. cadomensis is the only valid species.
facts.quote: In 2019, the taxonomy of Teleosauroidea was reviewed and T. cadomensis was seen as the only valid species.

facts.statement: Most other species previously assigned to Teleosaurus were absorbed into T. cadomensis or other genera.
facts.quote: The rest of the known species were absorbed into T. cadomensis or other genera.

facts.statement: Teleosaurus lived from the Toarcian to the Aptian stages, between 184.2 and 119.57 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Toarcian to Aptian (184.2 to 119.57 million years ago)

facts.statement: It is debated whether T. geoffroyi is a valid species or a synonym of T. cadomensis, with recent studies favoring synonymy.
facts.quote: T. geoffroyi, described on the basis of now destroyed mandibular fragments, was considered a valid species by Vignaud (1995), but it was made a probable synonym of T. cadomensis in 2020.
